acip: GNYIS PA NI, LUGS 'DI'I RNAL 'BYOR PAS SNYING GA'I SNA RTZER SNGAGS KYI THIG LE BSGOMS PAS STENG 'OG GI RLUNG RNAMS SNYING GA'I DH'U T'I'I NANG DU ZHUGS GNAS THIM GSUM BYAS PA LAS BYUNG BA'I SNANG BA'I YE SHES SKYES PA NAS BSGOMS STOBS KYIS SNYING GA'I RTZA MDUD RDZOGS PAR GROL DE RLUNG SNYING GA'I MI SHIGS PA LA ZHUGS GNAS THIM GSUM BYAS PA LAS BYUNG BA'I SNANG BA'I YE SHES MA SKYES PA'I GNAS SKABS KYI RDZOGS RIM NI, 'PHAGS LUGS KYI RDZOGS RIM LA RIM PA DRUG TU BYAS PA'I RIM PA GNYIS PA'I NGO BO'O,,
wylie: gnyis pa ni, lugs 'di'i rnal 'byor pas snying ga'i sna rtser sngags kyi thig le bsgoms pas steng 'og gi rlung rnams snying ga'i dhU tI'i nang du zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las byung ba'i snang ba'i ye shes skyes pa nas bsgoms stobs kyis snying ga'i rtsa mdud rdzogs par grol de rlung snying ga'i mi shigs pa la zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las byung ba'i snang ba'i ye shes ma skyes pa'i gnas skabs kyi rdzogs rim ni, 'phags lugs kyi rdzogs rim la rim pa drug tu byas pa'i rim pa gnyis pa'i ngo bo'o
english: This brings us to our second point from above--a description of transcendent speech.  Here now is the essential nature of the second stage within the stage of completion, according to the system of the realized being Nagarjuna, and assuming we are talking about the division of this system into six stages: The second stage begins when a deep practitioner of this system uses meditation upon sacred syllables within a drop at the opening of the channel at the heart to bring the upper and lower winds to enter, stay, and dissolve inside the channel of dance--thus giving birth to the wisdom of light.  And this stage continues up to the point where the practitioner is able to use their meditation to release the knot at the heart completely, thus giving rise to the wisdom of light which comes when the inner winds enter, stay, and dissolve into the indestructible drop at the heart.
